posts.title: Valkendorf on TV
posts.description: Last year I had the absolute honor of becoming [*efor*](https://universitetshistorie.ku.dk/leksikon/e/efor/) at Valkendorfs Kollegium. Valkendorfs is the oldest student residence in the Nordic countries, founded in 1589 and tucked away on Sankt Peders Stræde in the middle of Copenhagen. posts.title: Going home to NetSci: a keynote in Dresden
posts.description: Lots of people would "be humbled", but I have to say that I'm just excited, delighted, happy, elated, and exultant to be heading to Dresden in May 2027 to give a keynote at [NetSci 2027](https://netsci2027.github.io/). posts.title: New paper: social roles in Honduran village networks
posts.description: A quick post to celebrate a new paper out in *PNAS*: "Multiplex mapping of social roles in isolated Honduran village networks" [1]. It's the second paper from a wonderful collaboration with Nikolaos Nakis, Morten Mørup and Nicholas Christakis, following our *Nature Communications* paper from earlier this year [2].
